title: Clay Family Headstone Memorial, Cemetery Snapshot, B&W, 1980s
description: A black and white snapshot of a family gravestone in a churchyard cemetery, taken in or after 1986. The Gothic-arched headstone features inscriptions for family members including Ann Clay (died 1902) and grandson Ernest Clay (died 1903). A newer plaque at the base honors Jonathan Lawrance Clay (1894-1986). Shadows from surrounding mature trees cast across the grassy graveyard setting.
